caption: The drawing depicts a stylized yellow-green eagle with its wings partially open and facing forward. The eagle has a prominent beak and visible feather details on its body and wings. In the center of the eagle’s chest, there is a shield that also has a yellow-green hue and the word "Townsend" written in a cursive script across it. The eagle's talons are clutching a bundle of arrows on the viewer’s left and a branch, possibly olive, on the viewer’s right. A looped ribbon or banner encircles the base of the shield and the eagle’s legs. The composition is centered on a plain, light tan background. Near the bottom right of the drawing, the name "E. N. Dunne" is written in small capital letters.
title: Door Knocker
